codeReview.summary: The feature adds cache headers, but it still does not satisfy the required /dashboard/ SPA serving behavior and includes overly broad immutable caching logic for static assets.

issues.description: Only '/dashboard' is registered, not '/dashboard/'. With net/http ServeMux, GET /dashboard/ does not match this route and returns 404, so the expected behavior ('GET /dashboard/ returns React SPA index.html') is not met.

The immutable-cache condition uses `strings.Contains(assetPath, ".")`, which is true for nearly every file with an extension. This applies 1-year immutable caching to most `/assets/` files, not specifically hashed filenames as the comment/requirement implies.

sharedStateObservations.observation: Worker handoff uses a symbolic commit reference (`HEAD`) instead of an immutable SHA, which makes downstream review ambiguous once additional commits land.

The `fullstack-worker` procedure requires test-first backend+frontend coverage and full integration verification, but this feature was completed without added tests and without frontend test execution while still marked followedProcedure=true.
